race.comment: OUR COMBINATION (7) earns top billing after winning here last start and confirming her liking for the synthetic surface. Her Eagle Farm CL1 run the start prior was plain, but she has now won two of four this prep and returns quickly off the right performance. SHAME ON SUE (12) was beaten narrowly at the latest and is third-up with reliable distance form, making her a genuine winning threat if she doesn't have too much to do when rounding the bend. FAR BEYOND (5) was strong through the line when second in a CL1 here and has handled synthetic racing well, so he profiles as the next best chance with improvement second-up. BRECHEN (3) is knocking on the door and doesn't have to improve much to land a winning blow.
